about: Shared fixtures for the Kotlin and Swift ports of HeyTurbulence src/calendar-parser.js (P3 A3). Inputs are Google-Calendar-shaped events; expected values were produced by the JavaScript parser itself (catalog: android/app/src/main/assets/airports.json). Issue codes map the JS review notes: NO_FROM, NO_TO, SAME_AIRPORT, UNTIMED, CONFLICT, MULTI_LEG, STATED_TIMES. sourceId uses the prefix 'google:primary:'.
